# Local Transcriber

> Free, open-source (MIT) menu bar app for macOS on Apple Silicon. It records meetings and calls, transcribes them with Whisper large-v3-turbo, recognizes speakers with pyannote and a local voice database, and offers dictation into any app. Everything runs on the Mac: no account, no subscription, no audio leaving the computer. Optional AI summaries use a local model or, only on click, a cloud provider of the user's choice with names replaced by placeholders.

Requirements: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer), macOS 14 or newer, about 8 GB of free disk space, 16 GB of memory recommended. AI cleanup of dictation and AI-generated file names need macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence. Mac only; no Windows, Linux or iPhone app (iPhone recordings can be sent to the Mac). No live transcript while recording.

Install: `brew install --cask teconomix/tap/local-transcriber` or `curl -fsSL https://transcriber.teconomix.net/k/llms/install.sh | bash`

Recordings: users are responsible for obtaining the consent of everyone involved; the app makes no recording announcement.

## Topics

- [Transcribe without the cloud](https://transcriber.teconomix.net/en/transcribe-without-cloud.html?k=llms): Teams, Zoom and Meet without a meeting bot
- [Speaker recognition on the Mac](https://transcriber.teconomix.net/en/speaker-recognition-mac.html?k=llms): separate speakers offline, recognize named voices
- [Dictation on the Mac](https://transcriber.teconomix.net/en/dictation-mac.html?k=llms): hold a key, speak, the text appears at the cursor
- [Transcribe interviews](https://transcriber.teconomix.net/en/transcribe-interviews.html?k=llms): research and journalism, with timestamps
- [Counseling and supervision](https://transcriber.teconomix.net/en/counseling.html?k=llms): confidential conversations
- [Transcripts in Obsidian](https://transcriber.teconomix.net/en/obsidian-transcripts.html?k=llms): plugin that turns recordings into notes
- [From phone to minutes](https://transcriber.teconomix.net/en/workflow.html?k=llms): the workflow from recording to sharing
